use default
use System

christmas_days() -> Pipe[DateTime] is
    for year in 2008::2121 do
        yield DateTime(year, 12, 25)
    od
si

let sundays = christmas_days()
    |> filter(christmas => christmas.day_of_week == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY)

write_line("Christmas falls on a Sunday in:")
sundays |> each(christmas => write_line("{christmas:yyyy}"))
